turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Who decided on the zero, and was Owen heard first?
So do I. You haven't answered mine.
Either Owen admits it in writing by Friday at 3 PM or the zero goes on his transcript.
Admits it. Admits what, Hale, and under which section does a teacher put anything on his transcript? A threat is not evidence, so show me what you have or I take this to the principal today.
Those are the only two options. Pick one.
